scope: Partial audit checkpoint. All 1047 link pairs executed against the baseline matcher. Semantic validation of all returned spans, complete failure categorization and generalized fix are NOT complete.

existingMatcherRules.exact: Candidate literals tried first, longest candidates first. Exact tier has no uniform word-boundary guard. First successful regex tier wins per line.
existingMatcherRules.punctuation: Inconsistent across tiers: initial literal candidates retain terminal punctuation; later safe-frame/tokenizer rules handle some punctuation. Not universal.
existingMatcherRules.apostrophe: Straight and curly apostrophes supported by pattern generation; returned offsets/text refer to original text.
existingMatcherRules.contraction: No general contraction expansion/contraction equivalence layer. Some literal forms occur in pronoun/terminal patterns.
existingMatcherRules.placeholder: Initial candidates remove someone/somebody/something/~. Flexible tiers use bounded token slots; terminal punctuation can prevent flexible tokenization. Generic slots bounded to short spans.
existingMatcherRules.inflection: Heuristic regular suffixes on first eligible token; explicit irregular map be, come, fall, get, go, lose, make, take, throw. Not a complete morphology model.
existingMatcherRules.pronoun: Limited subject/object/possessive/reflexive substitution with fixed-anchor conditions. Generic one's / oneself is not systematically supported.
existingMatcherRules.separatedPhrasalVerb: Restricted type/headline and example-backed two-word handling; not universal.
existingMatcherRules.optionalToken: Parenthesized contents are removed, not systematically expanded as both present/absent alternatives. Limited inserted-modifier and optional-preposition patterns.
existingMatcherRules.explicitOverride: 169 hint definitions, 56 marked overrideMatcher. Valid exact matchText must occur uniquely on specified line. Without forced override, automatic results take precedence. Explicit match is fallback otherwise.
existingMatcherRules.multiRange: Explicit highlightRanges produces multiple ranges. Rendering selects nonoverlapping ranges, with highlightOnly priority; original text escaped into spans. Current automatic generic slot matches may include the variable slot.
existingMatcherRules.aliases: No general semantic alias dictionary. Examples participate only in restricted morphology/separation heuristics.
existingMatcherRules.falsePositiveGuard: No general speech-act/sense distinction guard. A returned range does not prove a correct semantic highlight.

brokenLinkCandidates.headline: per se
brokenLinkCandidates.reason: No corresponding expression in any of the 11 English lines; 'Technically, yes' is not per se.
brokenLinkCandidates.recommendedAction: Review the link separately; do not manufacture a highlight or change phraseLinks in this task.

brokenLinkCandidates.headline: call shotgun
brokenLinkCandidates.dialogueLine: Shotgun rules don’t really apply to train seats.
brokenLinkCandidates.reason: Other lines say 'call the train' and 'call it first'. None uses call shotgun; combining different turns would invent the target expression.
brokenLinkCandidates.recommendedAction: Review intended learning target and link in a separate data task.

brokenLinkCandidates.headline: Challenge extended
brokenLinkCandidates.reason: Issuing a challenge and accepting a challenge are different speech acts; inflection/variant matching must not equate them.
brokenLinkCandidates.recommendedAction: Review the link to the appropriate learning item separately.

brokenLinkCandidates.headline: register
brokenLinkCandidates.dialogueLine: Right! He was at the registration desk. / The event registry guy?
brokenLinkCandidates.reason: The linked record teaches the verb register. Registration and registry are different noun lexemes, not verb inflections.
brokenLinkCandidates.recommendedAction: Review the linked learning item separately; do not broaden verb morphology to these nouns.
